method: Remove declarations covered by a same-selector witness in an equal/broader numeric-width media interval. Witness wins by later order, important priority, or an additional leading html ancestor of body (HTML document equivalence, higher type specificity). Different values allowed only for basic numeric longhands accepted by CSS grammar; identical-value witnesses retain fallback syntax. No supports or nonnumeric media participation. No selector/at-rule/declaration reordering.
deferred: No full build, browser, deployment or live checks in CSS lane; parent performs one batched build and existing CI.
